item.title: Court upholds conviction of man who left child to freeze outside
item.description: A New York appellate court has upheld the conviction of Kevin Cox for the murder and assault of his girlfriend's six-year-old son in Troy. Cox was found guilty of two counts of second-degree murder and one count of first-degree assault after locking the child outside in freezing temperatures on February 9, 2020, to punish him for misbehaving.
